name: Sayla
source:
Sole daughter of the president of a large company, hailing from the United States, Sayla is half-Japanese from her mother's side and has longed to experience its culture for a long time. Her appearance may be youthful, but the truth is she's actually one of the older girls working at Dream Club. Her day job is at the local gym as a fitness instructor.

[spoiler]Her real name is Sara Sloan (紗羅・スローン).[/spoiler]
